description: Draw a map of one country with its first-level regions (states, provinces, prefectures, counties, departments) coloured by a number. Works for every country. Use region names or ISO 3166-2 codes (e.g. country 'US', region 'California' or 'US-CA'; country 'India', region 'Maharashtra'). For countries of the world use generate_world_map; for US counties use generate_county_map. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166 code, e.g. 'Germany' or 'DE'.

format.description: png (default) or svg. SVG returns a link to a vector version of the map.

labels.description: Write each area's name, value or both on the map (default none). Labels that don't fit are left out.

name: generate_country_map
title: Country map
